2105-4885-5895-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-4885-5895-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-4885-5895-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Splash Portal from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Splash Portal from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Splash Portal, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

240-5470-6791-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
240-5470-6791-7272.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

602-4691-7435.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
602-4691-7435.description:
Activate Hardened Academic by discarding a card.
Feast of Sanity triggers, dealing 1 damage to you and causing you to gain 1 life.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Hardened Academic ability, giving Hardened Academic lifelink until end of turn
Repeat

2023-2079-4289-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

147-4247-7446.easyPrerequisites: There's a nonland permanent card in your graveyard.
147-4247-7446.description:
Cast Moment of Reckoning by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Moment of Reckoning.
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Moment of Reckoning
Resolve the Moment of Reckoning copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2111-3545-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Sigil Captain triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2292-2728-6854-7957.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Rikku does not have summoning sickness.
2292-2728-6854-7957.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
2292-2728-6854-7957.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Host of the Hereafter and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 4.

225-851-2557-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2034-2820-4679-7730.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Angelic Renewal.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Yenna, adding {C}{C}.
When Yenna dies, both Angelic Renewals trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to sacrifice either Angelic Renewal and return Yenna from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

1362-1479-5671.description:
Play Oboro, Palace in the Clouds.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, The Necrobloom and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
In response, activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the The Necrobloom trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Oboro from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, The Necrobloom triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

1824-2530-2906-2932.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1824-2530-2906-2932.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost life this turn.
1824-2530-2906-2932.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Bontu's Monument triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

240-4885-5470-5686.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3899-4552-5902-7290.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Does Machines
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-3490-4050-4716.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3490-4050-4716.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

2054-3525-3586.description:
Activate Magus Lucea Kane by tapping it, adding {2} and causing you to copy the next ability you activate or spell you cast that has {X} in its cost.
Activate Urn of Godfire by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Magus Lucea Kane.
Repeat.
Once you have a large number of delayed triggers, cast a spell or activate an ability with {X} in its cost to have Magus Lucea Kane copy that spell or ability infinitely.

856-2034-5631-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Skeleton Crew trigger.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

1669-2292-5145-5466.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

586-3967-5258-5618-5687.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Skittering Precursor and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {3}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2919-5641-6097.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
2919-5641-6097.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

624-2947-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Phantasmal Image.
When Phantasmal Image dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Vesperlark.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Phantasmal Image's power.
Repeat.

865-1558-2963-4840.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact.
865-1558-2963-4840.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle and Mahadi trigger.
Resolve the Teleportation Circle trigger, blinking Myr Battlesphere.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing the Myrs and another artifact, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Mahadi trigger, creating at least four Treasure artifact tokens.
Repeat each turn.

3490-3761-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
3490-3761-5231.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Arcbound Crusher triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Arcbound Crusher triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Arcbound Crusher trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.
If desired, you may then sacrifice Arcbound Crusher to Thermopod to put its +1/+1 counters on any artifact creature you control.

1170-3363-4761.description:
Cast The One Ring by paying {4}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Teferi.
When The One Ring enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to gain protection from everything until your next turn.
Activate Teferi's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, returning The One Ring to your hand from the battlefield and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat during each of your turns.

229-724-1636-5220.notablePrerequisites:
Hidetsugu does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}{R}.
229-724-1636-5220.description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}.
Cast Endless One by paying {0}.
Endless One enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Intruder Alarm and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Endless One on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Hidetsugu's second ability by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, exiling Endless One from the top of your library and allowing you cast it this turn.
Repeat.

3026-4302-4802-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing an Angel.
Bishop of Wings triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
The Spirit enters the battlefield with at least two +1/+1 counters and becomes a 4/4 Spirit Angel due to having a +1/+1 counter on it.
Bishop of Wings triggers, causing you to gain four life.
Resolve Goblin Bombardment's ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Spirit token.
Repeat from step 2.

618-2645-4414-5313.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four additional creatures.
618-2645-4414-5313.description:
Tap Kiki-Jiki to create a token copy of Goldnight Redeemer with haste.
The token enters gaining you at least 12 life.
Pay 12 life to Treasonous Ogre to add {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Pay {1} to untap Staff of Domination and {3} and tap Staff of Domination to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

2556-4377-4428.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, getting an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Mnemonic Wall.
Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
